subject: general
question: Vasundhara Doraswamy was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (Akademi Puraskar) for the year 2019 for her contribution to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vasundhara Doraswamy **received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** (Akademi Puraskar) in **2019**.
 
• She was **honoured **for her significant contribution to **Bharatanatyam**, a **classical dance form of India**.
 
• The **award recognized** her expertise,** innovation**, and **dedication** to p**reserving and promoting Bharatanatyam**.
 
• **Vasundhara Doraswamy's** **artistic excellence and cultural impact** have earned her acclaim in the field of **classical dance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Akademi Award**

 
 
• The award was **established in 1952**.
 
• Includes **Hindustani Music**, **Carnatic Music**, **Dance**, **Theatre**, **Traditional/Folk/Tribal Music**, and **Puppetry**.
 
• The award carries a **cash prize**, **a shawl**, and **a citation**, and is considered **one of the highest honours** in the **Indian performing arts**.
 
• **Awarded annually** to **artists and scholars **who have made significant **contributions to Indian culture**.
